releaseNotes.zh: 设置更简洁，食材建议直接显示在表单内，助手操作减少弹窗，AI 点数与问题反馈更清晰。保留删除确认和未保存提醒。手动功能不消耗 AI 点；Android AI 仍使用现有邀请码。覆盖安装保留本地数据。
releaseNotes.en: Simpler settings, inline ingredient suggestions, fewer Agent popups, and clearer AI credits and feedback. Deletion confirmation and unsaved-draft protection remain. Manual tools use no AI credits; Android AI retains existing invitation access. Install over the existing app to retain local data.
